title: Align the tracks
prompt: Two arrays, left and right, have the same length. Return a new array where each item is left[i] plus right[i].
hints: Loop over positions so you can read both arrays at the same i.

docs.name: for i in range(n):
docs.what: Runs the indented lines with i counting 0, 1, 2 and so on.

docs.name: range(n)
docs.what: The numbers 0 up to n - 1, for a for loop to count through.

docs.name: list[i]
docs.what: The item at position i. Positions start at 0; -1 is the last item.

docs.name: list.size()
docs.what: Returns how many items the array holds.
